patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution organic imagery and textures are used as dominant background elements for most sections, creating immersive visual breaks.
Hero statements feature large, uppercase, wide-tracked sans-serif typography, creating a bold, editorial feel that contrasts with smaller, standard-case sans-serif for body text.
A sophisticated palette of deep earthy browns and warm skin tones is consistently accented by a vibrant, muted green for interactive elements and graphic overlays, with crisp white text for contrast.
The initial hero image scrolls up to reveal a secondary hero image with new content, creating a layered parallax effect, while a sticky navigation bar transforms from transparent to opaque.
Distinct page sections are visually separated by alternating full-bleed background imagery (soil, grass, human skin) or solid color blocks, establishing a strong visual rhythm and hierarchy.

technique_notes: The site employs a layered scroll-triggered reveal system where background images parallax and content blocks slide or fade into view as the user scrolls. This creates a dynamic sense of depth and progression.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay to a solid, light brown background with a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining visibility and brand presence.

Full-bleed background images and videos are used to define distinct sections, with text content overlaid and carefully contrasted for readability, often using a dark overlay or light text on dark backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, uppercase, wide-tracked hero headings (~4-5x body) with generous line height, paired with clean, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and key section breaks, becoming more balanced and structured in content grids like team member profiles.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of raw, organic textures and imagery (soil, grass, human skin, puzzle pieces) with a very clean, modern, and editorial sans-serif typography and layout. The layered scroll-triggered reveals and the unique green wavy line transition create a memorable and immersive visual journey.
